blocks.title: Image Block – Grip Edge
blocks.subtitle: Orange-gradient frame with the tool-grip top and bottom.
blocks.text: Add pes-frame-grip next to pes-frame on any Image widget to raise the top and bottom edges into a ribbed grip, like the bumper on a jobsite speaker.

blocks.title: Video Block
blocks.text: The same edge works on Video widgets. Paste the YouTube or Vimeo link and the frame and grip stay in place.

blocks.title: Navy Frame – Grip Edge
blocks.subtitle: The grip works on the navy frame too.
blocks.text: Use pes-frame pes-frame-blue pes-frame-grip for the navy version.
